//: Typecheck seam for compile-time contract assertions in test/. The main tsconfig.json excludes `test/` and `**/*.test.ts` — so the `satisfies`, assignability probes, and literal OpenccServerEvent bindings in openccRuntime-contract.test.ts never reach tsc. This dedicated config typechecks ONLY the contract test files (plus their imports), so the assignability probes in those tests actually fail the build when the contract drifts. Driven by the `typecheck:contract-tests` npm script in package.json — run via `pnpm --filter @zn-ai/zn-agent-core typecheck:contract-tests`, and as the second step of `typecheck`. (zai patch 2026-10-04 更正:原文写「also invoked as a pre-commit step in CI」—— 仓库里既没有 `.github/workflows` 也没有 `.husky`,没有这条 CI,该脚本只在有人手动跑时生效。) The `@zn-ai/zn-agent-core` main entry resolves to the BUILT `dist/bundle-entry.d.ts` (same mapping as tsconfig.consumer.json) so the probes check the published d.ts — which bundle-opencc produces from the source serverTypes.ts — without pulling the vendor `src/opencc-src` tree into tsc (its `MACRO.*` globals and stripped optional deps only exist at runtime/bundle time, not under tsc). The `bun:bundle` mapping is kept for the vendor tree's `bun:feature` references that surface in `openccRuntime-contract.test.ts`'s imports; `src/*` is dropped because nothing here resolves source-vendor paths anymore.
